query:
SELECT 
  b1.id as duplicate_id,
  b1.title,
  b1.authorId,
  b1.createdAt as duplicate_created,
  b2.id as keep_id,
  b2.createdAt as keep_created
FROM books b1
JOIN books b2 ON b1.title = b2.title AND b1.authorId = b2.authorId
WHERE b1.id < b2.id
ORDER BY b1.title, b1.authorId;
